title: Dormant Company Accounts
intro: We prepare and file your dormant company accounts with Companies House, ensuring full compliance while minimizing your administrative burden
includes: Completion of AA02 form & filing dormant company accounts (DCA)
Helping customers who almost reaching towards filing deadline
Confirming company house acceptance of accounts
Keeping your business active until you start trading
body: If a company has had no important accounting transactions within the financial year, it is classified as dormant; but, if it has settled any invoices, paid bank charges, bank interest, paid workers, or paid dividends to shareholders, it’ll lose its dormant standing, as these are all samples of important accounting transactions. Your company is named dormant if it has not had ‘significant’ transactions within the specific twelve-month period.The word ‘significant’ transactions don’t include:
Cash got shares once the corporate was incorporated

Our dormant company accounting service not solely includes filing of your dormant company’s accounts but additionally confirmation statement filing. We’ll collect all the information needed from you regarding your accounts and your business as an entire and update HMRC, file your confirmation statement and submit your dormant company accounts. This ensures that your business stays “active” till you choose to resume trading. In case you have not filed your confirmation statement or informed HMRC, you remain in risk of being affected by the register, which may impact your ability to seamlessly resume trading once you are prepared and ready. If you have formed your company through Brixen Consultants, we’ll already have all of your details except your bank statement, in addition, we also want confirmation on whether or not the shares in your company are paid or unpaid. By default, we’ll enter all shares as paid, however, if this is often not the case, you ought to advise us in writing or we will contact you before filing your accounts. Dormant company accounts services are for companies limited by shares or limited by guarantee.

A WebFiling authentication code could be a six-digit character set code issued by Companies House during registration for your company’s online filing. If you’ve registered your company through Brixen Consultants, you’ll have access to it at no cost by logging in to our online company manager. In case you formed your company from someplace else and don’t know your authentication code, we’ll get and send it over to you digitally or to your registered office address.
**Reach out to us if your company is dormant**

It may be a large downside for you when your company is dormant, non-working or non-trading. We will handle your dormant company’s accounts and file your annual confirmation statement. Our team can guarantee your company is compliant and meets all legal needs of filing your accounts till the day you select to resume trading. Every limited company needed to file accounts on an annual basis. If your company is classed as dormant (non-trading), you do not have to be compelled to file full accounts, however, you’re needed to file dormant company accounts. A professional secretary service for your business to remain complaint.Handle your dormant company’s accounts and file your annual confirmation statement with our professional team.
